_about: The neutral theme, and the default. Every word or picture that would name one particular lab lives in a theme file; this one names none. Another theme only needs the keys it changes: the rest fall back to these.

text.chronicle_foot: — live from the watch · click any watching to open it —
text.tribute_sub: The hypervisor divides its memory and its processors among its guests
text.annals_empty: nothing has happened on the map yet — the annals begin at the first change the watch sees.
text.colours_sub: the bar and the sky and depths
text.scheme_hint: Light/Dark keeps the bar light over the sky and dark over the depths. Saved in this browser.
text.nodes_sub: every place you may see, as the map has it now
text.nodes_failed: The places could not be read: {why}
text.nodes_empty: There are no places on the map yet.
text.nodes_not_drawn: That place is not on the map yet. Try again in a moment.
text.nodes_armed_one: Yes, I have checked this one
text.nodes_m_need: Say what the work is, and when it opens and closes.
text.nodes_m_order: It has to close after it opens.
text.nodes_s_unchanged: Nothing to change: {set} already says so.
text.nodes_h_label: Hide these from everyone outside the access group named
text.nodes_h_needed: Name the access group that may still see them.
text.nodes_n_needed: Pick at least one place they need.
text.nodes_n_unchanged: Nothing to change: they already say so.
text.nodes_stamps: Like a save in the map editor, this also marks them as checked.
text.nodes_stale_table: The map changed since this table was drawn. It has been drawn again: check the selection and press again.
text.nodes_readonly: This Atlas is read-only. Nothing here will save.
text.nodes_editor_failed: The map editor could not be opened: {why}
text.nodes_phone_bulk: Bulk actions need a wider screen.
text.ov_sub: what the map knows, at a glance
text.ov_failed: The overview could not be read: {why}
text.ov_not_drawn: That place is not on the map yet. Try again in a moment.
text.ov_states_none: There are no places on the map yet.
text.ov_states_degraded_one: No place is down; {n} of {total} is degraded.
text.ov_states_degraded: No place is down; {n} of {total} are degraded.
text.ov_states_unknown: The state of every place is not known yet.
text.ov_states_quiet: No place is down; {n} of {total} are up.
text.ov_down_undeclared: Nothing is declared to depend on these.
text.ov_down_undeclared_it: Nothing is declared to depend on it.
text.ov_maint_none: No maintenance in the next 7 days.
text.ov_review_none: Every place has been checked in the last 90 days.
text.ov_review_unchecked_one: 1 place is waiting to be checked.
text.ov_review_unchecked: {n} places are waiting to be checked.
text.ov_review_stale_one: 1 place has not been checked in 90 days.
text.ov_review_stale: {n} places have not been checked in 90 days.
text.ov_sources_unset: No live source is set up; the map is all there is.
text.ov_drift_none: The map agrees with its sources.
text.ov_ranges_none: No address ranges are described yet.
text.alerts_sub: word sent out when the map changes, and where it goes
text.alerts_failed: The alerts could not be read: {why}
text.alerts_off_both: Atlas sends nothing until two settings are in its environment: ATLAS_ALERTS=1, and ATLAS_ALERT_HOSTS listing the hosts it may send to, for example ntfy.example:443. No host is listed yet.
text.alerts_off_flag: The hosts it may send to are listed in ATLAS_ALERT_HOSTS. Set ATLAS_ALERTS=1 as well to turn alerts on.
text.alerts_off_hosts: ATLAS_ALERTS is set, but ATLAS_ALERT_HOSTS lists no host, so there is nowhere Atlas may send. List them as host:port, for example ntfy.example:443.
text.alerts_off_restart: Restart Atlas after changing its environment. Rules and destinations are made here once it is on.
text.alerts_poll_needed: Alerts need the annals' poll; it is off. Set ATLAS_ANNALS_POLL above 0 and run Atlas under gunicorn, or nothing will be sent.
text.alerts_poll_dead: Alerts need the annals' poll, and it is not running: it runs under gunicorn, never under flask run. Nothing is sent until it does.
text.alerts_no_link: ATLAS_PUBLIC_URL is not set, so messages will carry no link to the place.
text.alerts_stale: Someone changed the alerts while you were editing. They have been read again: make your change once more.
text.alerts_fix: That was not saved. Put these right first:
text.alerts_fix_form: That was not saved. The form says what to put right.
text.alerts_dest_none: There is nowhere to send yet. Add a destination first; a rule sends to one.
text.alerts_secret_hint: The server reads ATLAS_ALERT_SECRET_<NAME> or its _FILE; Atlas never stores the secret.
text.alerts_secret_unbound: the address changed, so ATLAS_ALERT_SECRET_{name} is not sent to it: edit it to name the secret again
text.alerts_in_use: Rules send here: {names}. Change them first.
text.alerts_rules_none: No rule yet. A rule sends word when a place, a set or a network changes.
text.alerts_f_minutes: And stays for (minutes; 0 sends at once)
text.alerts_resolution: Atlas looks every {n} seconds, so a wait is measured to the nearest {n} seconds.
text.alerts_resolution_off: Atlas measures a wait at the annals' poll, which is off.
text.alerts_suspended: Suspended: what it watches is hidden from a viewer with no groups, so nothing about it is sent.
text.alerts_rule_now: When {target} goes {states}, send to {dest} at once.
text.alerts_rule_wait: When {target} goes {states} and stays for {wait}, send to {dest}.
text.alerts_t_gone_place: a place no longer on the map ({id})
text.alerts_t_gone_set: a set that no longer exists ({id})
text.alerts_t_gone_network: a network no longer on the map ({id})
text.alerts_need_minutes: The wait is a whole number of minutes, from 0 to 1440.
text.alerts_need_url: Give the address to send to.
text.alerts_need_kind: Pick ntfy, Gotify or a JSON webhook.
text.alerts_bad_url: The address must start with https:// or http://.
text.alerts_bad_userinfo: The address may not carry a user name or password. Name a secret instead.
text.alerts_bad_query: The address may not carry a query (?…). Name a secret instead.
text.alerts_bad_host: {host} is not in ATLAS_ALERT_HOSTS, so Atlas will not send there.
text.alerts_bad_fragment: The address may not carry a fragment (#…).
text.alerts_bad_ntfy: An ntfy address names its topic, as https://ntfy.example/atlas.
text.alerts_bad_gotify: A Gotify address is the server itself, or ends in /message.
text.alerts_bad_secret: A secret's name is capitals, digits and _ only, at most 40 of them, as NTFY_LAB.
text.alerts_need_hour: The hour is a whole number from 0 to 23.
text.alerts_need_cert_days: Certificate days are a whole number from 1 to 365.
text.alerts_need_review_days: Review days are a whole number from 1 to 3650.
text.alerts_f_drift: Monitors the map has not charted
text.alerts_f_uncharted: Devices a source sees that the map has not charted
text.alerts_digest_off: The daily digest is not sent.
text.alerts_d_drift: monitors the map has not charted
text.alerts_d_uncharted: devices the map has not charted
text.alerts_deliveries_failed: The deliveries could not be read: {why}
text.alerts_l_fold: The changes held back by the rate limit
